stylePrefix: 90s American cable TV cartoon style, thick clean black ink outlines, flat cel animation colors, hand-drawn 2D animation look, warm appetizing dessert palette, polished Unity game dish sprite quality, funny, weird, charming, pure food only, no face, no eyes, no mouth, no limbs, no mascot treatment, no text, no logo, no watermark. The food must be fully opaque and complete. No transparent holes inside the food. Avoid magenta, hot pink, purple, and neon green inside the food because those colors may be removed by chroma key. No auxiliary lines, no guide marks, no grid lines, no crop marks.

typePromptPrefixes.dish: Dish sprite rule: one clean finished food sprite on a perfectly flat solid #FF00FF chroma key background. The background must be one uniform color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, or lighting variation. Do not use #FF00FF anywhere in the food. No cast shadow, no contact shadow, no table, no utensils, no plates unless the named dessert naturally requires a bowl, cup, cone, stick, or cake stand.
